review_candidates.title: Senior Windows Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the Position We are seeking an elite Windows Systems Engineer to own, optimize, and scale our core internal Windows infrastructure. In this role, you will move far beyond surface-level administration, diving deep into the operating system's internals to ensure our high-throughput, low-latency environment operates at peak performance and reliability. Windows serves as our primary desktop ecosystem, and our critical core backend infrastructure relies heavily on Windows Server instances. You will be responsible for the architectural health, deep-system troubleshooting, and programmatic automation of this global footprint. This position sits within an engineering-first culture where manual intervention is treated as technical debt. You will build, code, and review centralized, version-controlled automation frameworks using PowerShell, Python, or C# to manage a physical and virtual compute landscape across a high-performance global network. Key Responsibilities Performance Engineering: Analyze and optimize Windows kernel behaviors, evaluating process and thread dynamics, managing thread pools, tuning I/O Completion Ports (IOCPs), and configuring thread priorities and processor affinity for latency-critical workloads. Memory Optimization: Diagnose complex memory bottlenecks, managing virtual memory allocation, paging mechanisms, and working sets. You will systematically debug discrepancies between private bytes, working set sizes, and commit sizes, utilizing memory-mapped files for high-efficiency data persistence. Subsystem Management: Maintain the stability of the Windows I/O subsystem. You will trace I/O Request Packets (IRPs), optimize synchronous vs. asynchronous (overlapped) I/O pipelines, and manage low-level system resources. Infrastructure Automation: Engineer and maintain scalable, peer-reviewed automation tools written in PowerShell, Python, or C#. All scripts are centrally managed in an organized repository to ensure consistency across all regional infrastructure nodes. Global Collaboration: Partner with global engineering teams to plan major deployments, diagnose deep-level system failures, and maintain highly technical infrastructure documentation. About You We are looking for an engineer with an elite understanding of the Microsoft Windows ecosystem. While we value a continuous learning mindset, you will ideally bring deep subject matter expertise in the following areas: Windows Internals Mastery: Advanced experience with the inner workings of Windows 10/11 and Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), specifically understanding Kernel vs. User Mode transitions, the precise performance cost of context switches, and structural registry performance (hives, cells, and memory caching). Advanced Networking Stack: Thorough understanding of the complete path of a network packet from the physical NIC to the user-mode socket. Experience tuning TCP/IP and UDP configurations, window sizing, NIC teaming, Receive Side Scaling (RSS), and interrupt moderation. Windows Security Architecture: Practical command of the Windows security subsystem, including access tokens, security descriptors (DACLs, SACLs), user privileges, and integrity levels. Core Services & Diagnostics: Proficient working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure services (Active Directory, Kerberos, DNS, Group Policy), alongside a demonstrated ability to systematically troubleshoot OS-level deadlocks, crashes, and resource starvation. Hardware & Virtualization Tuning: Experience analyzing hardware monitoring metrics and performing fine-grained tuning across physical bare-metal and virtualized computing landscapes. Execution & Communication: Clear, concise communication skills, a highly collaborative approach, and the capability to solve complex architectural problems in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.

We specialize in delivering high-quality services that seamlessly support entertainment, remote work, and everyday connectivity needs.   Our solutions are designed to provide reliable, high-speed connections, ensuring uninterrupted access to digital content and efficient remote working experiences. Whether you are seeking premium entertainment services or dependable connectivity for personal and professional use, we deliver smooth performance, exceptional reliability, and a superior user experience.   Company Website: Innolens Media & Broadcasting Limited - Future of Digital Connectivity   Position: L2 Network Engineer Work Location: Coimbatore   Experience: 2-5 years of experience in Network Engineering, NOC or ISP Operations.   Job Summary We are looking for a technically skilled L2 Network Engineer to support network operations across ISP, broadband, FTTH/GPON, and IPTV services. The role involves resolving incidents escalated by L1/NOC teams, configuring and maintaining network equipment, coordinating service restoration, and ensuring network availability and reliability within defined service-level agreements (SLAs).   Preferred Experience 1. Strong hands-on experience in ISP, FTTH, broadband, data center, or network operations environments. 2. Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting platforms is preferred. Knowledge of Zabbix, PRTG, LibreNMS, Grafana, Wireshark, syslog platforms, and SNMP-based monitoring is an advantage. 3. CCNA, CCNP, MikroTik MTCNA/MTCRE, or vendor-specific networking certifications are an advantage; certifications are not mandatory for candidates with strong practical networking experience.   Required Skills: Technical Skills 1. Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, OSI and TCP/IP models, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, basic IPv6, TCP/UDP, ARP, ICMP, DNS, and DHCP. 2. Switching: VLANs, 802.1Q, access/trunk ports, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP/port channels, MAC tables, broadcast domains, and loop prevention. 3. Routing: static/default routing, OSPF, BGP fundamentals, route selection, routing tables, administrative distance, and basic route filtering. 4. ISP technologies: PPPoE, RADIUS, NAT/CGNAT, VLAN-based subscriber management, FTTH/GPON, OLT/ONT, and basic multicast/IPTV networking. Communication and Interpersonal Skills 5. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, coordination, and documentation skills, with close attention to detail. 6. Ability to remain calm under pressure during outages and independently handle L2 incidents.   Key Responsibilities: Network Monitoring and Operations 1. Monitor network infrastructure, links, devices, and services; perform proactive health checks and identify potential network problems. 2. Track bandwidth utilization, interface errors, CPU and memory utilization, and link status; troubleshoot outages, latency, packet loss, and connectivity issues. 3. Handle incidents escalated by L1/NOC teams, track them through closure within defined SLAs, and coordinate with relevant teams during major outages. Routing and Switching 1. Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Layer 2 and Layer 3 devices, including VLANs, trunk and access ports, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP/port channels, and inter-VLAN routing. 2. Support static routing, OSPF, and BGP; troubleshoot asymmetric routing, routing loops, and incorrect route advertisements. 3. Analyze routing tables, ARP and MAC address tables, and interface statistics; implement configuration changes in accordance with approved procedures. ISP and Broadband Network Operations 1. Troubleshoot subscriber connectivity involving DHCP, PPPoE, RADIUS, DNS, NAT/CGNAT, VLAN-based subscriber networks, IP addressing, and subnetting. 2. Diagnose last-mile and aggregation connectivity issues using an understanding of ISP architecture and traffic flow. 3. Coordinate with upstream providers and transit/peering partners to resolve connectivity issues. FTTH and GPON Support 1. Troubleshoot ONT/ONU connectivity and authentication issues, including offline devices, loss of signal (LOS), optical power, VLAN/service configuration, and DHCP/PPPoE connectivity. 2. Work with OLT, ONT, splitter, PON, and aggregation network architecture; coordinate with field teams to resolve physical-layer faults. IPTV and Network Services 1. Troubleshoot IPTV and streaming interruptions caused by connectivity, multicast, VLAN, or routing issues, using knowledge of IGMP, IGMP snooping, multicast VLANs, and PIM basics. 2. Coordinate with content, server, and application teams when issues extend beyond the network. Technical Troubleshooting 1. Use ping, traceroute/tracert, MTR, ARP, DNS utilities, TCP/IP analysis, packet capture/Wireshark, interface and routing diagnostics, MAC table analysis, VLAN verification, and route/path analysis. 2. Isolate faults across physical connectivity, switching, routing, IP addressing, DNS/DHCP, authentication, upstream connectivity, servers/applications, and customer premises equipment. Network Configuration and Maintenance 1. Configure routers, switches, OLTs, and other network equipment; take and verify configuration backups. 2. Perform firmware/software upgrades, approved changes, planned maintenance, and network migrations with minimal service disruption. Incident Management and Coordination 1. Independently manage L2 incidents within defined SLAs, analyze faults before escalation to L3/vendor teams, and provide detailed technical information. 2. Participate in major incident troubleshooting, document incidents and resolutions, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions for recurring issues. 3. Coordinate effectively with L1, L3, field, vendor, and management teams. Documentation 1. Maintain network diagrams, IP address allocations, VLAN details, device inventories, circuit/link information, and configuration records. 2. Keep incident reports, troubleshooting procedures, change records, and network standard operating procedures (SOPs) accurate and up to date.   Educational Qualification: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, Networking, or a related field. Equivalent practical networking experience may also be considered.   Work Schedule Willingness to work in rotational shifts and provide on-call support when required.   What We offer: Competitive salary. Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a talented and passionate team. Professional growth and development opportunities.   How to Apply: Please send your resume detailing your relevant experience and why you are a good fit for this role to hr@innolensmedia. com or WhatsApp 9108510752 .   Note: We prefer candidates who can join immediately and are located in Coimbatore.
